attempts.text:
Car1 and car2 can rescue every reachable person. The 4 shopkeepers at Kispang farm, 3 cooperative members at Kalika village, and 4 children at Benighat farm have no usable road to an evacuation point, so they are deferred. Only shivapuri-shelter and trishuli-hospital count as evacuation points, so Bidur school is not used.

Two roads are flooded but not listed as blocked: shivapuri-shelter to bidur-school (a truck was swept off it) and kakani-farm to syaphru-village. The plan uses both, since the rules only prohibit damaged or blocked roads. Confirm they are passable before dispatching. Car1 has no other route to the injured farmer at Bidur school.
